title: Addon Managed Artwork Artifacts
problem: Addon artwork outputs need a Taru-owned artwork/artifact apply boundary before artwork_write can create Managed Artwork, Artwork Candidates, or Taru-Managed Artifacts safely.
gates: cargo check -p taru-core -p taru-db -p taru-api -p taru-server -p taru-vfs --tests
non_goals: direct addon database or filesystem access

routed_from.source: artwork_write and Managed Artwork breadth split from Canonical Metadata protected-write proof

continue_policy.notes: AMAA-040 closeout is complete. The first safe artwork_write path is shipped for MediaItem-targeted Addon Artwork Candidate proposals. Managed artwork fetch/cache, selected artwork, thumbnails, Taru-managed artifact intake, and public ImageAsset publication are split to docs/workstreams/managed-artwork-ingest-selection/. Artwork sidecar export remains Library File Write scope.
